newsitem.title: FRANCE: Havas rises on hopes of better value.
newsitem.headline: Havas rises on hopes of better value.

text.p: Shares in French media group Havas firmed on Thursday, on hopes one of its core shareholders, Alcatel Alsthom, would push it to boost shareholder value, market sources said.
"Serge Tchuruk seems to have shaken the tree and we will see what falls out," said a fund manager, who noted that Havas has had one of the worst performances on the stock market this year.
Newspaper La Tribune reported that Alcatel chairman Tchuruk had lunch with Havas chairman Pierre Dauzier in mid-November and asked him to work out a strategy to improve asset value.
Havas shares traded up 5.44 percent to 362.60 francs, on volume of 277,000 shares at 1415 GMT. The market was up 0.78 percent.

La Tribune reported that Tchuruk asked Dauzier "to find a real strategy to increase the value of the assets". The lunch was said to have taken place after a stormy board meeting. Dauzier has gone to work on the project, the newspaper said.
Engineering group Alcatel holds 21.2 percent of Havas.
